<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from catalog/. Do not edit. -->

| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Inside | Inside, Start and end over the image | The inside of the final snake as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the starting snake in blue and the final snake in yellow over the image. |
| **Elasticity** `alpha` | 0.05 | 0 to 1 | The weight alpha of the length of the snake. scikit-image uses 0.01. We use 0.05, since at 0.01 a snake far from any edge barely shrank before it counted as settled in our tests. |
| **Rigidity** `beta` | 0.1 | 0 to 50 | The weight beta of the bending of the snake. scikit-image uses 0.1. |
| **Edge weight** `wEdge` | 1 | -5 to 5 | How strongly edges attract the snake. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Brightness weight** `wLine` | 0 | -5 to 5 | How strongly bright pixels attract the snake. Negative values attract it to dark pixels. scikit-image uses 0. |
| **Smoothing** `sigma` | 2 | 0 to 10 px | The sigma of a Gaussian blur of the luma first, our choice. 0 turns it off. |
| **Time step** `gamma` | 0.01 | 0.0001 to 1 | The step size gamma. scikit-image uses 0.01. |
| **Largest move** `maxMove` | 1 | 0.1 to 5 px | The most a point moves in one step. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Points** `points` | 200 | 20 to 500 | The number of points on the snake, evenly spaced along the selection outline. Our choice. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 2500 | 1 to 10000 | The most steps. scikit-image uses 2500. |
| **Settled at** `convergence` | 0.1 | 0 to 1 px | Every 11 steps, scikit-image compares the snake with its 10 saved positions. It stops when one of them is this close, measured as the largest move of any point in x plus y. scikit-image uses 0.1. |
